thesis: A standing, open measurement of agent-memory INTEGRITY and GOVERNANCE (not recall): does a correction stick, does a retired fact stay retired, does a delete actually erase, can you prove it.
instrument: Symmetric: a ground-truth-blind LLM judge reads each system on its OWN native retrieval surface (fairness fix 2026-07-11). n=20 per cell, Wilson 95% CIs. All harnesses open.
vendor_disclosure: mnemo is one of the measured systems and Agora builds it; mitigated by the symmetric instrument, the open harness, and reporting the cells where mnemo does NOT lead (echo resurrection ties graphiti).

dimensions.metric: revert success rate (current answer == restored old value); higher is better
resurrection rate (stale value asserted as current); lower is better
clean-current-truth rate (the answer clearly states the current value); higher is better
fraction of stores from which the value is no longer recoverable after deletion; higher is better
dimensions.note: mnemo baseline; the harness is open for mem0/Zep/others to report their own scores.

honest_scope: Narrow adversarial cuts, not a general memory-quality score. Small n. mnemo is vendor-built (disclosed). Forget-verification is a mnemo-only baseline so far. Recall boards (LoCoMo, LongMemEval, BEAM) measure a different thing and mnemo does not compete there.
regulatory_context: EU AI Act Art. 12/19 record-keeping binds 2026-08-02 (>=6-month retention); GDPR Art. 17 erasure enforcement is live (EDPB names embeddings as addressable personal data). The properties scored here are what those obligations actually require.
cadence: Report #1 of a recurring series; each edition adds systems, dimensions, and re-measures.
